title: WrathUnleashed in the browser
comment: The one streamed slice. Each tier has a stable "key"; "order" lists the keys in priority order and a tier's number is its position there (move a key to reorder, delete it to drop the tier). Tiers are exported in that order until budgetMB; maxTier is the highest tier number the server actually holds ("Make mini slice.bat" lowers it to what fit; the gate passes it to the realm). The realm rule reads the same file (lua/tiers_lua.py makes ov_slices_tiers.lua from it), so nothing is listed twice. A map entry is the whole map, or a "zone" (AreaTable id, tiles from its world-map rect), or a world "box" [x min, x max, y min, y max]; marginTiles widens the streamed tiles, the realm rule uses the zone or box itself. Tier 0 (base) and Dalaran are always first.

lite.comment: Item models and textures are worn by everyone (spec kits, free Armory gear) and there are too many to pick from, so all of them ship, with textures cut to their mips of at most maxPx on the long side. --export reports what that saved.

soundPolicy.comment: Which tier kinds take their zone music and ambience (wenilla-host --deps walks them from each tier's areas and WMOs; a tier's own "music" / "ambience" true or false wins). What a tier does not take is deferred to the tier with "collectDeferred": true, the last in "order", so dungeon and raid music only streams if the budget leaves room. Doodad, game-object and creature-footstep sounds are always taken. Only the tiles inside a map entry's zone or box give music and ambience, never its marginTiles.

lowLevel.comment: Stream characters below this level live in their faction's starter area and capital; from it on, the Dungeon Finder and the whole .play menu open.

tiers.name: base
tiers.notes: Login, character select and create for every race and class, the UI, spell effects, interface and character sounds, liquids, the shared models. Shared by every other tier. The boot read-set (boot-manifest.json, world-manifest.json) is exported before it. Not all of Textures\ (the whole world's minimap and every baked NPC skin): the map tiers add the minimap tiles and baked NPC skins they need; the --record check finds the rest.
tiers.prefixesNote: Textures\* is only the files directly in Textures\ (unitselecttexture, shadowblob, waterpoop02, the sun and moon, minimapmask): the textures the client names in its own code. Footprints, weather, spell chain beams (ropebeam), water splashes and guild emblems (tabards) are small and needed everywhere. The base also gets every liquid loop and the ghost and underwater ambience by walking (wenilla-host --deps), and the minimap index md5translate.trs below.
capture: Start the local host with --record names-0.txt, open the page, wait for the login screen.
Log in, open character create, click through every race, both genders and every class, rotate the model.
Create one character of each armor type if you can (cloth, leather, mail, plate) and log each in once.
tiers.mountsNote: Every player mount's model and skins (horses, rams, wolves, kodos, raptors, mechanostriders, hawkstriders, elekks, gryphons, wyverns, drakes, mammoths, motorcycles...), the flight masters' mounts and a vehicle mount's passengers: displays.py reads Spell.dbc for aura 78 and prints those displays for this tier. Mounts are ridden everywhere and are not spawned anywhere, and the client seats a rider only once the mount's model has loaded, so they belong in the base. About 100-250 MB.

tiers.name: Dalaran
tiers.notes: Dalaran (zone 4395 on Northrend, map 571): the city, the Underbelly (sewers) and the Violet Citadel. Only the ADT tiles under Dalaran's world-map rect plus one tile of margin; anything else on Northrend sends a stream player back.

maps.tilesNote: WorldMapArea has no rect for Dalaran (all zeros), so the zone alone streamed the middle of Northrend (31-33 x 31-33). These are the tiles under the city (x from world y, y from world x: Northrend_30_21 holds 5808, 588); the realm rule still uses zone 4395.
maps.spawnBoxNote: x min, x max, y min, y max: the creature and object spawns displays.py reads for Dalaran. No z min: the city floats above Crystalsong Forest, whose tiles stream with it, and the stags, herb nodes and taxi birds below are seen from the city (the live capture asked for them).

capture: Log in a character who is in Dalaran (GM: .tele Dalaran).
Walk the rings: Krasus' Landing, the Violet Citadel (inside and up), the bank, the Eventide and Magus Commerce, Runeweaver Square, the Antonidas memorial, both inns.
Go down to the Underbelly (.tele DalaranSewer) and walk it to the Black Market and the Arena entrance.
Open the map (M) and both Dalaran floors.

tiers.name: Stormwind City
tiers.notes: Stormwind City (zone 1519 on Eastern Kingdoms, map 0): the Alliance capital. Only the ADT tiles under its world-map rect plus one tile of margin, like Dalaran; a stream player elsewhere on map 0 (outside Northshire) is sent back.

maps.spawnBoxNote: x min, x max, y min, y max: the creature and object spawns displays.py reads for the city

capture: GM: .tele Stormwind, then walk every district: Trade, Cathedral, Old Town, Dwarven, Mage Quarter, the Park, the Keep, the Harbor.
Ride the Deeprun Tram entrance only to the door (the tram map 369 is not streamed).

tiers.name: Orgrimmar
tiers.notes: Orgrimmar (zone 1637 on Kalimdor, map 1): the Horde capital. Zone tiles plus one tile of margin.
capture: GM: .tele Orgrimmar, then walk every valley: Strength, Spirits, Wisdom, Honor, the Drag, Grommash Hold, the zeppelin towers.

tiers.name: Northshire Valley
tiers.notes: The Alliance starter area for stream players: Northshire Valley (area 9 of Elwynn Forest, zone 12, map 0). Bounded by a world box (box: x min, x max, y min, y max) because a subzone has no world-map rect; the tiles under the box plus marginTiles are streamed and the realm rule keeps a stream character below 15 inside the box (and Stormwind City). Every Alliance race starts here in the browser: dwarves, gnomes, night elves and draenei are moved here on their first login.
capture: Make a human character and log in (Northshire Abbey). Walk the valley: the abbey, the vineyards, Echo Ridge Mine (inside), the wolf meadows, the gate to Elwynn.

tiers.name: Goldshire Inn (guest pass)
tiers.notes: The Leyline guest pass ("Try it" on the website, stream/demo.py + realm ov_demo.lua): the Lion's Pride Inn in Goldshire (Elwynn Forest, zone 12, map 0) and the village around it. Kind "base" on purpose: it adds files only and opens no place to anyone in the realm rule (ov_slices.lua never lets a stream player into a base tier); guest characters are held in the inn by ov_demo.lua instead. The ground under the box is ADT Azeroth_31_49 and Azeroth_32_49 (x from world y, y from world x), which Northshire's margin already streams, so this tier's own cost is the inn's WMO and doodads (walked from those tiles) and the village's creature and object displays (spawnBox). Next to Northshire in "order" so it is exported early.

maps.spawnBoxNote: x min, x max, y min, y max: Goldshire village (the inn, the smithy, the guards, the regulars)

capture: Log in a guest-pass character (or GM: .tele Goldshire, then walk into the Lion's Pride Inn).
Walk the inn's ground floor and upstairs rooms, step out onto the porch, turn the camera all the way round.
With ?boottrace=1 this capture is the guest pass's world-entry read-set (see stream/README-stream.md, Guest pass).

tiers.name: Valley of Trials
tiers.notes: The Horde starter area for stream players: Valley of Trials (area 363 of Durotar, zone 14, map 1). World box like Northshire. Undead, tauren and blood elves are moved here on their first login.
capture: Make an orc character and log in. Walk the valley: the den, the boar and scorpid fields, the Burning Blade Coven (inside), the road towards Razor Hill.

tiers.name: Ebon Hold (Death Knight start)
tiers.notes: Acherus: The Ebon Hold and the Scarlet Enclave (map 609, zone 4298): where every Death Knight starts at 55. Zone tiles plus one tile of margin (the map is only the Enclave). The chain ends at Light's Hope Chapel (Eastern Plaguelands, not streamed): a stream Death Knight is then sent to its capital.
capture: Make a Death Knight and play the start: Acherus (all floors), Death's Breach, New Avalon, the mine, Havenshire, the Scarlet fleet.

tiers.name: arenas
tiers.notes: The five 3.3.5a arenas. Arena maps cannot be teleported into without a match: queue a skirmish with a GM character and a second account, or check the walk with --record while a match runs.
capture: Two local accounts in one group: queue a 2v2 skirmish at an Arena Battlemaster until you have seen each arena once.
GM shortcut without a match: .go xyz <x> <y> <z> <map> does not work in arena maps; rely on --deps for these and use the skirmish run as the check.
tiers.text: Arenas (Nagrand, Blade's Edge, Ruins of Lordaeron, Dalaran Sewers, Ring of Valor): queue a skirmish or rated game from an Arena Battlemaster or the PvP window.

tiers.kindNote: home, as Dalaran: the realm's stream rule (ov_slices.lua) lets every player stand here at any level, so a browser player in a Den is never sent away; no play entries, so the travel menu doesn't offer it.
tiers.name: Den
tiers.notes: The Den (owner 1 Nov 00:16: a light, fully working Den in the browser, the slice way): the sealed island in the far north-east of Kalimdor where every Den room stands (ov_build.lua DEN: map 1, 16226.2, 16257.0, game_tele 424 GMIsland), and the models of every object a Den can place: the Builder's catalog and buildings, the room's floor, wall and light blocks, and the stamps' and starter places' props. Objects found with '.build find' or '.build models' outside these are not carried (a player's own game folder shows them). Right after Dalaran in order (1 Nov 00:49: at the end, the budget left it out), so it always fits.

maps.boxNote: x min, x max, y min, y max: the room (OV_DEN_SIZE up to 32 yards each way) and its yard around 16226.2, 16257.0, with room to look around: tiles Kalimdor_1_1 and its neighbours.

tiers.objectsNote: Gameobject entries whose models stream with this tier (displays.py: a tier's objects): ov_build.lua CATALOG and its buildings, ov_den.lua LOOKS (floor, wall, light), den-stamps/*.den.json and den-starters/*.den.json. stream/tests/test_den_slice.py keeps it in step with them.
capture: Hop to a Den realm in the browser: you start in the white room.
.den start forest, then .den stamp inn now; walk around the Inn and the yard.

tiers.name: Dungeon, raid, arena and battleground music
tiers.notes: Not a place: the zone music the dungeon, raid, arena and battleground tiers left out (soundPolicy), collected here by wenilla-host --deps. Last in order, so it streams only if the budget leaves room; without it those places play their ambience and effects with no music.

notStreamed: The open world beyond the starter areas and capitals, questing outside them, Wintergrasp, Alterac Valley, Isle of Conquest, the Deeprun Tram.
